resources.string: Wɔde nhyehyɛe yi ka ho firi otomeehyɛn app mu
Browsa ntumi nnya kwan daa. Fa ka ho firi app te sɛ Tasker, MacroDroid anaa Automate plugin nsensanee mu.
Paw \"Namaz Akışı\" firi app te sɛ Tasker, MacroDroid anaa Automate plugin nsensanee mu na fa ka ho.
Wosiw app yi kane sɛ ɛnkyerɛ wo Nyamefrɛ. Wobɛtumi ama kwan wɔ Namaz Akışı mu wɔ Nhyehyɛe > \"App a ɛkyerɛ Mayɛ Nyamefrɛ\" ase.

%1$s betumi ahunu berɛ a Nyamefrɛ berɛ du, berɛ a ɛreba awieɛ ne berɛ a wowɔ masjid, na ayɛ wo otomeehyɛn. Wobɛtumi asesa wo gyinaeɛ wɔ Namaz Akışı mu wɔ Nhyehyɛe > \"App a ɛkyerɛ Mayɛ Nyamefrɛ\" ase.
%1$s betumi de otomeehyɛn a woahyehyɛ akyerɛ Nyamefrɛ a ɛkɔ so no sɛ wɔayɛ. Wobɛtumi asesa wo gyinaeɛ wɔ Namaz Akışı mu wɔ Nhyehyɛe > \"App a ɛkyerɛ Mayɛ Nyamefrɛ\" ase.
Berɛ a Nyamefrɛ berɛ reba awieɛ (%1$d min aka, Nyamefrɛ Wɛmfoɔ abue)
Sɛ Nyamefrɛ berɛ reba awieɛ a (%1$d min aka, Nyamefrɛ Wɛmfoɔ abue)
Sɛ wɔhunu sɛ wowɔ masjid a
